message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Defendant Wei purchased prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from Li, intending to resell for profit. He also deceived victim Yu by promising high profit from buying and reselling cultural relics, got 5 million RMB, used money for other purposes, later gave back 1 million and gave low-value artifacts as compensation. The artifacts are classified as level-3 cultural relics (state-protected). The prosecution says the behavior constitutes "×× and fraud". Likely crimes: "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade of cultural relics) and "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also possibly "非法获取国家文物" but that's part of illegal trade. Under Chinese Criminal Law, illegal trade of cultural relics is covered by Article 277 (illegal trade of cultural relics). Also fraud is Article 266. So answer: [罪名]非法买卖文物罪;诈骗罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: Using victim's money for personal consumption could be "挪用资金" but that's part of fraud. The main crimes are illegal trade of cultural relics and fraud. So output accordingly.
